title: The node panel writes and edits a brief: the approach and the acceptance list
name: panel-brief
description: The server has `write_brief` and the dashboard never calls it, so a node reaches `needs-brief` and the only way on is a host session or the CLI. Add a form in the panel's Brief section: approach as markdown, the acceptance list as one command per row (ADR 0027), and complexity if the record carries it. Saving goes through `write_brief`; approval stays the separate button it already is. Delete write_brief from KNOWN_GAPS. Waits on brief-toggle, which reshapes the same section.
